newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mosenergo plans share authorisation, after 2-3 mos.
newsitem.headline: Mosenergo plans share authorisation, after 2-3 mos.

text.p: Russian regional power utility Mosenergo will consider increasing authorised capital at an extraordinary meeting but not within the next two to three months, a company securities department official said on Monday.
Mosenergo approved a 50 rouble dividend at its annual meeting and re-elected chief executive Nestor Serebryanikov and chairman of the board Anatoly Kopsov.
"The question of additional share issues has not been deleted from the agenda," the official said. "It will be decided and worked out."
"I expect that an extraordinary meeting (to discuss the issue) will not be held in the next two or three months -- and we would have been told if one had been planned."

The board of directors last week dropped a proposal from the agenda for the Monday annual meeting to increase authorised capital by 800 million shares, about 30 percent, but Serebryanikov said that the issue would still be worked on.
At 1325 GMT Mosenergo was $1.250 after closing at $1.293 on Friday.
